content:
Creates a bulk operation task to add agents to a custom network.
Requires the Scan Manager [40] user role. See Roles.
AUTHORIZATIONS:
cloud
REQUEST BODY SCHEMA:
application/json
string
The UUID of the network to add the agents to.
object
Specifies the criteria you wish to filter agents on. The criteria is used to
narrow down the list of agents to perform the specified action on.
Array of String for Agent UUIDs (OPTION 1) (string) or Integer for Agent IDs
(OPTION 2) (integer)
An array of agent IDs or agent UUIDs to add to the criteria filter.
network_uuid
required
criteria
items
Content type
Array of String for Agent UUIDs (OPTION 1) (string) or Integer for Agent IDs
(OPTION 2) (integer)
An array of agent IDs or agent UUIDs to exclude from the criteria filter.
